agenda_text:
City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
December 6, 2010
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of city plaque to Public Safety and Traffic Commissioner Stella Bennett.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: November 1 and 15
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report submitting progress report for public works projects. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report submitting investment and treasury report for the month of September. RECEIVE AND FILE.
h.
Report submitting request for "Keep Clear" pavement markings for eastbound Lomita Blvd at Cypress Street. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting request for additional parking on north side of Palos Verdes Drive North west of Western Avenue. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report submitting letter of resignation from Planning Commissioner Popelka. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Report recommending purchase of an asphalt zipper with trailer in the amount of $92,170 from Asphalt Zipper Inc and a drag-a-box material spreader in the amount of $13,809.76 from J. Pyott and Associates as sole source acquisitions for use in the public works department. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending purchase of 106 water meters in the amount of $34,198.10 from Measurement Control Services as a Sole Source Acquisition for the Public Works Department. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report recommending suspension of a water rate study until costs to operate the water reservoir, treatment plant and water well are able to be assessed for a minimum period of six months. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
n.
Report recommending award of a Professional Services Contract to Willdan Geotechnical in the amount of $16,720 for Geotechnical Services for Streets and Waterline Improvements Phase 1(A) and Pacific Coast Highway Water Main Replacement Projects. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
ANIMAL CONTROL ORDINANCE Public hearing on an ordinance amending Chapter 4 of Title III - Animals by making modifications to the Department of Animal Care and Control animal license enforcement fees and delinquency charges.
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
MASSAGE ESTABLISHMENTS Report presenting information on the city’s massage establishments.
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
ADJOURNMENT Adjourn in memory of Bernadene Smith and Ann Smisek.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
